description: A trip to Eureka's founding era changes the present, forcing Carter and his friends to live with an altered timeline while the Astraeus mission gradually becomes the town's defining project.

s04e01.description: During Eureka’s anniversary celebration, Carter, Allison, Jo, Henry and Fargo are thrown back to 1947 and must return without altering the town’s history, but scientist Trevor Grant is pulled forward with them.

s04e02.description: The group returns to a present altered by its trip to 1947 and must adapt to changed relationships and careers while a runaway Global Dynamics project called Tiny causes trouble during Founders’ Day.

s04e03.description: A frustrated scientist’s experimental compound spreads extreme aggression through Global Dynamics, turning suppressed irritation into violent rage and making Fargo a particular target.

s04e04.description: During Space Week, an oxygen-generating technology intended for Mars begins producing a chain reaction that could ignite Eureka, leaving the town without Carter while he visits Zoe at Harvard.

s04e05.description: Warehouse 13 agent Claudia Donovan visits Eureka and becomes caught in a wave of objects appearing from nowhere around town, forcing her, Carter and Fargo to trace the dimensional anomalies.

s04e06.description: Carter takes Kevin camping while a malfunctioning artificial-intelligence system at Global Dynamics turns normally helpful machines dangerous, and Henry wrestles with whether to tell Grace the truth about the altered timeline.

s04e07.description: Residents begin turning to stone just as Carter grows jealous of Grant’s pursuit of Allison, Henry tries to build a real marriage with Grace and Zoe hides a relationship from her father.

s04e08.description: People from Carter and Allison’s pasts reappear just as their relationship begins to work, while a new Global Dynamics project attracts Beverly Barlowe’s attention and threatens the fragile alternate timeline.

s04e09.description: The D.E.D. device disappears and evidence points toward Grant, forcing Carter, Jo, Fargo and Allison into a case that could expose Beverly’s plan and undo everything changed since 1947.

s04e10.description: A Christmas celebration goes wrong when Eureka becomes sealed inside a force field, leaving Carter to solve the crisis while Fargo throws the Global Dynamics holiday party and the town tries to preserve the season.

s04e11.description: A malfunctioning launch system sends Fargo and Zane unexpectedly into orbit while Carter tries to keep Andy and S.A.R.A.H.’s wedding from collapsing into another Eureka-scale disaster.

s04e12.description: A mysterious song triggers unusual behavior across Eureka, drawing Fargo into the phenomenon while Carter manages Allison’s children and a rocket scientist appears at Café Diem.

s04e13.description: Jo embraces predictive security lenses until she and Carter see a projection of Eureka’s destruction, while Fargo and Holly Marten begin screening candidates for the Astraeus mission.

s04e14.description: A bank robbery coincides with residents and buildings developing bizarre gravity problems, leaving Carter to connect the theft with the town’s new physical instability as Fargo competes with Isaac Parrish for Holly’s attention.

s04e15.description: Zoe returns to find Jo living the life she remembers with Zane, but their conflict is interrupted when everyone in Eureka falls unconscious and Beverly moves to steal critical Global Dynamics data.

s04e16.description: Senator Wen arrives to evaluate Global Dynamics just as ravenous robotic mites begin consuming materials across the facility, while Allison refuses to acknowledge possible aftereffects from Beverly’s implants.

s04e17.description: Preparations for Titan accidentally begin transforming Eureka’s environment into Titan-like conditions, while the DOD investigates whether Carter and Allison’s relationship creates a conflict of interest.

s04e18.description: Attacks around town threaten the Astraeus program as the final crew is selected, and a memory-reading device used during interviews exposes private experiences Carter and Allison would rather keep private.

s04e19.description: An explosion in the Astraeus lab accidentally transports Andy to Titan, forcing the team to improvise a rescue before the distant moon’s environment destroys him.

s04e20.description: As the Astraeus crew prepares to depart, Carter and Jo investigate an attack on the presidential convoy and growing cosmic anomalies that may threaten both the mission and Eureka itself.
